screen.title: Design system
screen.subtitle: Direction C · Calm Night · development screen
screen.languageHint: The app reloads when the text direction changes

colors.title: Colours
colors.note: Each colour on the surface it is read on, with its contrast ratio. 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text and marks.

type.title: Type, spacing and icons
type.note: Rubik for the interface and Teko for numbers. A 4-point grid.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.note: Primary, secondary, row, text, icon and danger, in every size and state (section 1).

identity.title: Avatars, flags, rating and league
identity.note: Every avatar size in the four player colours and the neutral frame, with its badges (sections 2, 4 and 5).

cards.title: Player cards
cards.note: The 2-player card in every state, and the compact cards for 3 and 4. Every state comes from a real engine game (sections 3, 7 and 8).

hud.title: Lead bar, lock strip and badges
hud.note: The lead bar for 2 and 3–4 players, my lock strip in each state, and the small badges (sections 6, 9 and 10).

board.title: Board
board.note: Every cell state on one board, from a 4-player engine game (section 11). Always left to right.

keypad.title: Keypad
keypad.note: Armed, idle, a completed digit and a digit already tried (section 12). Always left to right.

overlays.title: Sheet and dialogs
overlays.note: Sheet, surrender confirm, end practice and the centred dialog (sections 13 and 14).

screenStates.title: Empty, error and loading
screenStates.note: The empty state, no connection and connection error with a support code, and the loading skeleton (spec 4.1 and 16.3).

rows.title: Rows
rows.note: Cards with an avatar, not tables: a history row, a leaderboard row, my row (pinned) and their skeleton.

fields.title: Fields
fields.note: The account screens' fields: plain, email, password, error and disabled.

screenStates.emptyBody: Your first game will show up here.
screenStates.offlineCaption: No connection, with a support code
screenStates.offlineBody: Ranked games need a connection. You can practice alone or against a bot.
screenStates.errorCaption: Connection error, with a support code
screenStates.errorBody: You're online, but the server didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
screenStates.rules: Empty: a quiet picture, a short title, one sentence and one action. Error: a plain explanation, "Try again" and a small code. Loading: a skeleton of the same shape that pulses slowly, and stands still with reduced motion on.

rows.me: My row · pinned at the bottom

fields.name: Display name
fields.note: Tap a field to see its focus state. Email and password are always left to right.

colors.playersNote: I am always P1, cyan with a circle. Opponents get P2 to P4 in seat order, with a triangle, a square and a diamond.
colors.paletteLabel: {{name}}, shape: {{shape}}, digit on tint {{digit}}, ring on ground {{ring}}

buttons.pressHint: "Pressed" is live: press and hold any button to see it.
buttons.caption: {{size}} · {{state}}

identity.leaguesNote: Each row: the text version (Home) and the version with the hexagon, for each tier.

cards.pairNote: Tap ⚡ to open or close the arsenal, and tap reactions to open or close the picker.
cards.interferenceNote: When the opponent disconnects or leaves the game, the button is not shown.

hud.nudge: Nudge (as when a key is pressed without a cell)

board.note: Tap an empty cell to see it waiting for the lock. Tap an opponent's lock to see "taken".
board.legend: On the board: givens, cells solved by all four players, my lock (F8), opponents' locks (A8, and D4 stopped by an interference), and wrong digits on an empty cell, on a solved cell and under my lock.
board.closeUps: Cells up close: states the board can't show at the same moment

cells.paused: My lock, stopped by an interference

keypad.armedCaption: Digit {{digit}} is complete, and one digit was already tried in the cell
keypad.idleCaption: Pressing a key nudges "Pick a cell"

toasts.success: You're back in the game. Board and scores are in sync
toasts.error: Not enough points for the next interference ({{cost}} pts)
toasts.send: Send a toast through the queue
toasts.sendNote: Each tap sends the next type. Toasts arrive one after another at the top of the screen.

sheet.caption: Sheet (arsenal)
sheet.title: Interference arsenal
sheet.subtitle: Target: {{name}}
sheet.scrim: Close the arsenal and return to the board
sheet.body: Each interference lasts 5 seconds · launch by dragging only
sheet.rowSub: 2 pts · drag onto the opponent's card

surrender.caption: Surrender confirm
surrender.title: Are you sure you want to surrender?
surrender.body: The game counts as a loss · estimated rating change
surrender.footnote: The game goes on in the background
surrender.label: Confirm surrender

dialog.caption: Centred dialog
dialog.title: No internet connection
dialog.body: You can keep practising offline. Ranked games come back when the connection does.

online.title: Online game
online.subtitle: Development screen · private room with a code
online.identityAccount: Signed in: the server knows you by your account
online.createHint: The room code to share shows once it is created
online.badCode: That is not a room code. 6 characters, no 0, O, 1, I or L

status.lobby: In the room, waiting for players

metrics.title: Network measures
metrics.subtitle: The current online game · the last 200 samples of each measure
metrics.none: No online game is open. Create or join a room on the "Online game" screen.
metrics.offset: Clock offset from the server: {{ms}} ms
metrics.offsetNone: The clock is not synced yet
